title: Roasted Mushroom and Chickpea Salad with Lime and Avocado
blurb: Warm roasted mushrooms and chickpeas tossed with creamy avocado, fresh basil and a sharp lime dressing.
steps: Heat your oven to 200°C. Halve or quarter the mushrooms so they are roughly even sized, then drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Toss the mushrooms and chickpeas on a baking tray with half the olive oil, the crushed garlic, salt and pepper. Roast for 20 minutes until the mushrooms are golden and the chickpeas slightly crisp.
While they roast, juice the lime into a small bowl and whisk in the remaining olive oil with a pinch of salt.
Halve the avocado, remove the stone and scoop the flesh into chunks.
When the mushrooms and chickpeas are done, let them cool for a few minutes, then combine in a bowl with the avocado.
Tear the basil leaves over the top, pour over the lime dressing and toss gently to coat everything.
